page_title: UNI 0-0 FRE | Union Berlin v Freiburg 08/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

90+3' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards the top of the net from a promising distance, but Noah Atubolu denies him. Union Berlin get a corner.
90+3' The free kick from long range, taken by Union Berlin, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vincenzo Grifo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Florent Muslija (Freiburg).
90+2' Julian Schuster is stunned as referee Tobias Reichel shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+2' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) commits a rough foul. Tobias Reichel stops the game and makes a call. A free kick to Union Berlin.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
89' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

88' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle and it's Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Freiburg win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
88' A cross from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

87' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) times his leap well to meet the lofted pass from Eren Dinkci, but his close-range header slips just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
86' Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
85' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) is flagged for offside.
84' The referee signals a substitution. Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Aljoscha Kemlein.
84' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Freiburg have a free kick.
83' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Frederik Ronnow makes a great save.
80' Great teamplay by Freiburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

79' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Tobias Reichel blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. That's a free kick to Union Berlin.
78' A substitution has been made. Robert Skov is replaced by Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin).
77' Substitution. Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) has come on for Lukas Kubler.
77' It's time for a substitution. Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) comes on in place of Patrick Osterhage.
77' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Junior Adamu and he is replaced by Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
76' Flag up against Tim Skarke (Union Berlin). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
73' Today's match ends for Woo-Yeong Jeong who will be replaced by Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin).
73' Substitution. Yorbe Vertessen leaves the pitch and is replaced by Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
72' Bo Svensson decides to make a substitution. Benedict Hollerbach will be replaced by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin).
72' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tobias Reichel blows for a foul. Free kick. Union Berlin will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
70' A brilliant cross into the box finds Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin), who directs his header towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.

69' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Noah Atubolu was alert and the score remained the same.
62' The linesman signals that Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
61' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) unleashes a sweet first-timer from the edge of the box to the left side of the goal. The goalkeeper stops the shot with a quick save.
59' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) commits a foul and Tobias Reichel immediately signals a free kick. It's a free kick to Freiburg, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
59' Now Union Berlin have a corner.
58' Great save! Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Noah Atubolu.
57' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
56' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) duly receives a yellow card.
54' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul. Freiburg are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
54' The resulting corner from Robert Skov (Union Berlin) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
53' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Union Berlin force their opponents to concede a corner.
50' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the right side of the target, but Noah Atubolu keeps it out with an amazing save.
50' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Robert Skov (Union Berlin), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
50' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Tobias Reichel stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Union Berlin have a free kick.
48' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is adjudged offside.
47' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) sends a chip pass into the box, but Noah Atubolu is quickest to intercept the ball.
46' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Julian Schuster (Freiburg) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

44' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
44' Corner kick. Robert Skov (Union Berlin) is ready to send the ball into the box.

43' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass. Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
42' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Tobias Reichel signals. Union Berlin are awarded the free kick.

38' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) releases a powerful first-time effort from the edge of the box which goes in the direction of the middle of the target, but the keeper reacts quickly enough to deny him. Excellent goalkeeping!

35' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is free in the box and Patrick Osterhage finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
34' Union Berlin couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
33' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg). Union Berlin are awarded a free kick.
33' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.
31' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
31' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
31' This shall not pass! Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
29' A pass lands at the feet of Junior Adamu (Freiburg) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
28' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle and signals a foul after Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) brought his opponent down. Freiburg have been awarded a free kick.
28' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Freiburg.

22' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
21' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the bottom left corner, but Frederik Ronnow leaps out to thwart his attempt.
21' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
21' It’s a PENALTY to Freiburg after the VAR review!

20' Play continues despite the shouts by some Freiburg players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Tobias Reichel interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
19' Freiburg have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.

19' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul. Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee. Freiburg win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
18' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) probably handled the ball. Freiburg will take a free kick near the side line.
16' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) tries to find Benedict Hollerbach, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
13' Freiburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
12' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
11' Tobias Reichel has a clear sight and sees a foul from Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg). There is a free kick near the sideline to Union Berlin.

11' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
10' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

9' Christian Gunter crosses and Junior Adamu (Freiburg) misses a great opportunity with his head from close in, sending the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
8' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) brings an opponent down and Tobias Reichel interrupts the game. Freiburg are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
4' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) was waiting for the ball on the edge of the box and produced a powerful volley goalwards, but the goalkeeper made an amazing save and to deny him.
2' Freiburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Noah Atubolu, who smothers the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Tobias Reichel.
